prompt:
Workflow step: Use the mobile robot arm to move the silicone container from workbench to mobile robot platform.
Inspection timing: before this step
Inspection location: workbench
What the inspection checks: Check whether two silicone containers are on workbench.

A description of the inspection camera's photograph follows, written by someone who was not told what is being checked.

Description: Centre foreground: a white opaque plastic wash bottle stands upright on a white holder/base mounted on a grey metal rail track. It has a green band around its upper body and a red screw cap with a red angled spout/nozzle projecting to the right; the cap is seated on the bottle and the spout tip is open. Contents are not visible through the opaque body.

Left: a white and black robotic arm with a gripper, plus a black articulated stand, a blue and black device, and a small screen on a bench. Background: laboratory room with white walls, ceiling strip light, a desk with monitor and black office chair, a white cabinet/fridge at right with small bottles on top, and a door. Foreground bottom left: a white sheet with a printed marker pattern.
observations: The workbench view shows only a single white wash bottle on a holder, with no silicone containers visible; two silicone containers are not present as required.
